source.acceptance_criteria: A single canonical skill source is implemented or a documented decision keeps both; all skill runtime/release gates pass.
source.description:
PROBLEM: The repo has both root skills/ and .xtrm/skills/default with overlapping content. This is the largest line-saving candidate but also touches source-root discovery and runtime skill materialization.
SCOPE: Decide the canonical source for built-in skills, update findRepoRoot/source repo detection, registry generation, materialization, docs, and release gates accordingly.
GITNEXUS_EVIDENCE: findRepoRoot impact CRITICAL: direct callers include claude, clean, init preflight, install-pi, pi, spec apply/doctor, and status. discoverDefaultSkills and rebuildAllRuntimeActiveViews are also CRITICAL.
SUCCESS: One canonical skill source remains, active runtime views still build, package payload still includes required skills, and user fallback remains intact.
NON_GOALS: Do not delete either tree before proving package/install/runtime behavior end-to-end.
VALIDATION: npm run gen-registry; npm run check:registry-pack-parity; npm run check:skills-ownership; npm run check:layout-guards; skills materializer/discovery tests; xt init smoke.
source.title: Ponytail cleanup: resolve root skills vs .xtrm/skills/default source split
